title: Laoag City heat index reaches 39°C, same level expected Tuesday

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Residents of Laoag City in Ilocos Norte were urged to take precautions against heat-related illnesses after the city recorded a heat index of 39 degrees Celsius on Monday, Nov. 16, with the same level expected on Tuesday, Nov. 17. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) classifies heat indices ranging from 33°C to 41°C under “Extreme Caution” where prolonged exposure may cause heat cramps and heat exhaustion, while continued physical activity could lead to heat stroke.
